note: Both sets extract the same core facts (40W incandescent, 9W CFL, 7W LED light-output equivalence, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement) with accurate quotes and conditions. Set B is a superset of Set A but adds only a third duplicate of the T24 fixture requirement (stated once without conditions and once with), whereas Set A's duplicates are limited to the 40W incandescent and vacancy-sensor claims. Both sets omit the Title 24 requirement that high-efficacy luminaires be on their own switch in kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms, and both ignore the LIGHTING LEVELS table (3/5-10/30/50 FC and the 40W-bulb counts per task). Since Set A carries fewer redundant claims and nothing extra that is wrong, it is marginally better.
remarks: Neither set captures the LIGHTING LEVELS table in the page image (illuminance targets 3 FC, 5-10 FC, 30 FC, 50 FC with corresponding 40W bulb counts and activities) nor the Title 24 own-switch requirement for kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms — the most substantive engineering content on the page is missed by both. Both sets also repeat the 40W incandescent and vacancy-sensor claims verbatim; the vacancy-sensor pair differs only in how much of the quote is copied into the value field.
